snippet.title: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle – Nintendo Direct: Partner Showcase 2.5.2026
snippet.description:
Indiana Jones and the Great Circle swings onto Nintendo Switch 2 physically and digitally on May 12, 2026. Pre-order today: 
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Adventure calls! Indiana Jones and the Great Circle delivers an immersive, cinematic adventure experience that puts you firmly into the boots of the legendary archaeologist.

#IndianaJones #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoDirect

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
